verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security platform, so a built-in risk register is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a risk register, risk scoring, treatment plans, risk owners, or review cycles linked to controls. The closest items are adjacent features (code-security findings triage, policy templates, control management during framework removal), and none of them is a risk register.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls
